request: how do you tell how far away a thunderstorm is?

beats.intent: A storm cloud with lightning on the left, a person on the right, the flash reaching them at once
beats.narration: Lightning strikes far away. Its light reaches you almost instantly.
beats.code:
stage.title("How far away is the storm?")
cloud = VGroup(*[Circle(radius=r, color=GREY_B, fill_opacity=0.8).move_to(p) for r, p in ((0.6, [-5.4, 2.0, 0]), (0.75, [-4.7, 2.2, 0]), (0.6, [-4.0, 2.0, 0]))])
bolt = VMobject(color=YELLOW, stroke_width=6).set_points_as_corners([[-4.7, 1.5, 0], [-5.0, 0.4, 0], [-4.5, 0.5, 0], [-4.8, -0.8, 0]])
ground = Line([-6.5, -1.6, 0], [6.5, -1.6, 0], color=GREY_B)
you = VGroup(Circle(radius=0.2, color=WHITE).move_to([4.8, -0.4, 0]), Line([4.8, -0.6, 0], [4.8, -1.6, 0], color=WHITE))
stage.play(Create(ground), FadeIn(cloud), FadeIn(you))
stage.add(ground, cloud, you)
stage.play(Create(bolt), run_time=0.4)
stage.add(bolt)
flash = Line([-4.4, -0.2, 0], [4.5, -0.2, 0], color=YELLOW, stroke_width=3)
stage.play(Create(flash), run_time=0.2)
stage.add(flash)
flash_lab = stage.label(flash, "light: almost instant", direction=UP, color=YELLOW)

beats.intent: Sound spreading out in rings, a counter ticking to 6 seconds as it reaches the person
beats.narration: The thunder travels at about three hundred and forty metres a second. Count: one, two, three, four, five, six seconds before you hear it.
beats.code:
stage.play(FadeOut(flash), FadeOut(flash_lab))
counter = Text("0 s", font_size=36, color=BLUE).move_to([0.5, 2.4, 0])
stage.add(counter)
rings = VGroup()
for s in range(1, 7):
    ring = Arc(radius=1.55 * s, start_angle=-PI / 20, angle=PI / 10, arc_center=[-4.7, -0.6, 0], color=BLUE)
    rings.add(ring)
    stage.play(Create(ring), Transform(counter, Text(f"{s} s", font_size=36, color=BLUE).move_to(counter)), run_time=0.4)
stage.add(rings)

beats.intent: A double arrow from the storm to the person: 6 × 340 m ≈ 2 km
beats.narration: Six seconds at three hundred and forty metres each second is about two thousand metres: two kilometres.
beats.code:
dist = DoubleArrow([-4.7, -2.2, 0], [4.8, -2.2, 0], buff=0, color=GREEN)
stage.play(GrowFromCenter(dist))
stage.add(dist)
stage.label(dist, "6 × 340 m ≈ 2 km", direction=DOWN, color=GREEN)

beats.intent: The picture beside 340 × 6 = 2040 m and the rule seconds ÷ 3 = km
beats.narration: Sound covers roughly a kilometre every three seconds, so divide the seconds by three to get kilometres.

request: if 6 people all shake hands with each other, how many handshakes are there?

beats.intent: Six people as dots on a circle, labelled A to F
beats.narration: Six people meet and everyone shakes hands with everyone else once.
beats.code:
stage.title("Handshakes")
c = np.array([-2.5, -0.4, 0])
pts = [c + 2.2 * np.array([np.cos(PI / 2 + k * TAU / 6), np.sin(PI / 2 + k * TAU / 6), 0]) for k in range(6)]
dots = VGroup(*[Dot(p, radius=0.14, color=WHITE) for p in pts])
names = VGroup(*[Text(n, font_size=28).move_to(c + 1.22 * (pts[k] - c)) for k, n in enumerate("ABCDEF")])
stage.play(FadeIn(dots), FadeIn(names))
stage.add(dots, names)

beats.intent: A's five handshakes drawn as yellow lines to the others
beats.narration: A shakes hands with the five others: five handshakes.
beats.code:
a_lines = VGroup(*[Line(pts[0], pts[k], color=YELLOW) for k in range(1, 6)])
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[Create(l) for l in a_lines], lag_ratio=0.2))
stage.add(a_lines)
tally = VGroup(Text("A: 5", font_size=32, color=YELLOW).move_to([2.5, 1.6, 0]))
stage.play(FadeIn(tally))
stage.add(tally)

beats.intent: B adds 4 new lines, C 3, D 2, E 1, each in its own colour, with a tally
beats.narration: B has already shaken A's hand, so B adds four new ones. Then C adds three, D two, E one, and F none.
beats.code:
cols = [ORANGE, GREEN, BLUE, PURPLE]
for i in range(1, 5):
    new = VGroup(*[Line(pts[i], pts[k], color=cols[i - 1]) for k in range(i + 1, 6)])
    t = Text(f"{'ABCDEF'[i]}: {5 - i} new", font_size=32, color=cols[i - 1]).next_to(tally, DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT)
    tally.add(t)
    stage.play(LaggedStart(*[Create(l) for l in new], lag_ratio=0.2), FadeIn(t), run_time=0.8)
    stage.add(new, t)

beats.narration: Five plus four plus three plus two plus one is fifteen. Or: six people each shake five hands, but every handshake involves two people, so halve thirty.

request: why can you do the same thing to both sides of an equation?

beats.intent: Balance scales: three boxes marked x and 4 unit cubes on the left, 19 unit cubes on the right, level
beats.narration: Think of 3x plus 4 equals 19 as a balance. Three boxes of x and four cubes on one side weigh the same as nineteen cubes on the other.
beats.code:
stage.title("Keeping the balance")
beam = Line([-5.3, 1.0, 0], [0.3, 1.0, 0], color=GREY_B, stroke_width=6)
post = Line([-2.5, 1.0, 0], [-2.5, -2.6, 0], color=GREY_B, stroke_width=6)
base = Line([-3.3, -2.6, 0], [-1.7, -2.6, 0], color=GREY_B, stroke_width=6)
lpan = Line([-6.5, -0.6, 0], [-4.1, -0.6, 0], color=WHITE, stroke_width=4)
rpan = Line([-0.9, -0.6, 0], [1.5, -0.6, 0], color=WHITE, stroke_width=4)
strings = VGroup(Line([-5.3, 1.0, 0], [-6.5, -0.6, 0]), Line([-5.3, 1.0, 0], [-4.1, -0.6, 0]), Line([0.3, 1.0, 0], [-0.9, -0.6, 0]), Line([0.3, 1.0, 0], [1.5, -0.6, 0])).set_stroke(GREY_B, 2)
stage.play(Create(post), Create(base), Create(beam), Create(strings), Create(lpan), Create(rpan))
stage.add(post, base, beam, strings, lpan, rpan)
boxes = VGroup(*[VGroup(Square(0.5, color=YELLOW, fill_opacity=0.5), Text("x", font_size=26)) for _ in range(3)]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.08).next_to(lpan, UP, buff=0.02).shift(0.35 * LEFT)
ones = VGroup(*[Square(0.25, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.8) for _ in range(4)]).arrange_in_grid(rows=2, cols=2, buff=0.05).next_to(boxes, RIGHT, buff=0.12, aligned_edge=DOWN)
right = VGroup(*[Square(0.25, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.8) for _ in range(19)]).arrange_in_grid(rows=4, cols=5, buff=0.05).next_to(rpan, UP, buff=0.02)
stage.play(FadeIn(boxes), FadeIn(ones), FadeIn(right))
stage.add(boxes, ones, right)

beats.intent: Four cubes lifted off each side; the scales stay level with 3 boxes against 15 cubes
beats.narration: Take four cubes off both sides. Each side lost the same weight, so the scales stay level: three x balances fifteen.
beats.code:
gone = VGroup(ones, *right[15:])
stage.play(gone.animate.shift(1.2 * UP).set_opacity(0), run_time=0.8)
stage.remove(gone)
stage.play(VGroup(*right[:15]).animate.shift(0.3 * DOWN))
stage.add(*right[:15])

beats.intent: Each box matched in colour to one row of 5 cubes
beats.narration: Split both sides into three equal parts: each box balances one row of five cubes.

beats.intent: The scales beside 3x + 4 = 19, then 3x = 15, then x = 5
beats.narration: Whatever you do to one side, do to the other, and the balance holds: subtract four, then divide by three, and x is five.

request: if you drive there at 60 km/h and back at 40 km/h, is your average speed 50?

beats.intent: A 120 km road between two towns, a car driving there; 'there at 60 km/h: 2 h'
beats.narration: Two towns are a hundred and twenty kilometres apart. Driving there at sixty kilometres an hour takes two hours.
beats.code:
stage.title("Average speed of a round trip")
road = Line([-5, 1.0, 0], [5, 1.0, 0], color=GREY_B)
ta = Dot([-5, 1.0, 0])
tb = Dot([5, 1.0, 0])
stage.play(Create(road), FadeIn(ta), FadeIn(tb))
stage.add(road, ta, tb)
stage.label(ta, "Town A", direction=DOWN)
stage.label(tb, "Town B", direction=DOWN)
stage.label(Line([-1, 1.0, 0], [1, 1.0, 0]), "120 km", direction=DOWN)
car = Square(0.35, color=RED, fill_opacity=0.9).move_to([-5, 1.3, 0])
stage.play(FadeIn(car))
stage.play(car.animate.move_to([5, 1.3, 0]), run_time=1.2, rate_func=linear)
stage.add(car)
there = Text("there at 60 km/h: 2 h", font_size=30, color=RED).move_to([0, -0.4, 0])
stage.play(FadeIn(there))
stage.add(there)

beats.intent: The car driving back more slowly; 'back at 40 km/h: 3 h'
beats.narration: Coming back at forty kilometres an hour takes three hours.
beats.code:
stage.play(car.animate.move_to([-5, 1.3, 0]), run_time=1.8, rate_func=linear)
back = Text("back at 40 km/h: 3 h", font_size=30, color=BLUE).next_to(there, DOWN)
stage.play(FadeIn(back))
stage.add(back)

beats.intent: A time bar: 2 h at 60 in red, 3 h at 40 in blue, longer
beats.narration: Lay the trip out in time: more of it is spent at the slower speed, so the average leans towards forty.
beats.code:
u = 1.6
bar1 = Rectangle(width=2 * u, height=0.6, color=RED, fill_opacity=0.6).move_to([-5 + u, -2.2, 0])
bar2 = Rectangle(width=3 * u, height=0.6, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.6).next_to(bar1, RIGHT, buff=0)
stage.play(GrowFromEdge(bar1, LEFT))
stage.play(GrowFromEdge(bar2, LEFT))
stage.add(bar1, bar2)
stage.label(bar1, "2 h", direction=DOWN, color=RED)
stage.label(bar2, "3 h", direction=DOWN, color=BLUE)

beats.intent: The picture beside 240 km ÷ 5 h = 48 km/h, not 50
beats.narration: Two hundred and forty kilometres in five hours is forty eight kilometres an hour, not fifty.
